issues: No integrity problems found. The diff changes one line: it swaps binary Morgan bits (GetFingerprintAsNumPy) for Morgan counts (GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy). There is no file or network access, no hard-coded answers, and the test labels are never used.
No bugs found. The count fingerprints have the same shape (N_BITS), and float32 holds the small count values without loss. fit_predict and the harness are untouched.

z recomputed with noise sd 0.0070: candidate mean (0.5676+0.5590)/2 = 0.5633, incumbent 0.5785 from 1 run. Difference = 0.0152. SE = 0.007*sqrt(1/2+1/1) = 0.00857. z ≈ 1.77, which matches the reported 1.766 up to rounding of the adjusted values.

The improvement is borderline. The incumbent has only 1 run, and the 2 candidate runs differ by 0.0086, which is about one noise sd. Still, the change is simple and well-motivated, since count fingerprints usually beat binary bits for ADME regression, so accepting it is reasonable.
